body:
Found live: colab_train.py still called rl_train_packet.py with the pre-S459-54 single-agent flags (--port/--opponents/--out), which no longer exist after S459-54 rewrote that script into the real 3-role league orchestrator. Running the Colab cell would have failed immediately with an argparse error, training nothing. Rewired to invoke the real league orchestrator (--league-dir/--output-dir/--registry-url/--resume-from-registry), which self-pushes each generation to the registry. Verified live: rl_train_packet.py accepts every flag colab_train.py now passes (confirmed via a real invocation that got past argparse into a real registry auth call), full python -m unittest suite (35 tests) green. Commit f1face3.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-59: fixed colab_train.py regression -- invoked a CLI rl_train_packet.py no longer has
